body:
Found live while restarting IDUNA for the CarePyre PII-audit deploy (unrelated to that work): journalctl showed real, recurring OOM-kills against the 256M ceiling starting well before this session's own restart, compounding under this session's own heavy Apple-filing traffic (each emily apples post triggers an apples-git sync subprocess). Host has 9GB+ available. Bumped MemoryMax to 512M as an immediate, safe stopgap -- root cause of the memory growth not diagnosed here, named honestly as a separate follow-up. Confirmed stable via a 3-minute journalctl watch, zero further OOM events, /health OK throughout. Commit c750901.

⚓ ☃
title: Stabilize iduna.service: bump MemoryMax 256M->512M (OOM-kill stopgap)
